svg.title: Best compression, one cell at a time
svg.desc: Technical report Figure 2b: mean compression ratio over 734 raw and normalized CELLxGENE matrices, with each codec applied to independent units of 1 or 2,048 consecutive cells. CellPack keeps per-cell access (one cell per unit) in its 4,096-cell chunk layout.
